cohort: 118 patients with previous abdominal surgery who underwent a subsequent surgical procedure
finding: The umbilicus was found to be a safe entry site for primary trocar insertion in patients with a history of Pfannenstiel incision, but a higher probability of umbilical adhesions was observed in patients who had undergone umbilical mesh repair, median incision, or major abdominal surgery.
mod_finding: Adhesions were reported in 37.5% (33 out of 88) of the patients with a previous history of cesarean section.
